changes.request: Useful context actions on Markdown and web reading previews
changes.cause: Native Markdown and shell-rendered web Reader surfaces had no common reading capabilities or context-menu route.
changes.implementation: Capability-based native menus; captured selection and owner/window/tab validation; copy, Google search, HTTP links, select all, scoped find and supported exports.

changes.request: Find results visible in web Reader before exiting
changes.cause: Find was routed by web tab kind into the hidden native page while the visible article lived in the shell.
changes.implementation: Route by visible surface; shared rendered-text ranges, scoped CSS highlights and wraparound next/previous; stop native find on entry, replay on exit and reject late native counts.

changes.request: Export the reading preview to Markdown and PDF
changes.implementation: Export the owned cached article snapshot without refetching or replacing an active document; sanitized HTML, Turndown/GFM, source metadata, safe merged tables and hidden full-article PDF print. Export modules load only when requested.

changes.cause: Current public DOM uses hashed classes and nested div paragraphs, which ordinary Readability can lose.
changes.implementation: Host-limited semantic section-root extraction from a clone, scaffold/control removal, leaf-div paragraph conversion, tables/anchors/footnotes/details retained, shared live/reader block coordinates.

namuPrimaryEvidence.fixture: Public HTML captured by ordinary HTTP, served without executing scripts or requesting external assets
namuPrimaryEvidence.title: 키스 길

previewContract.display: Isolated Xvfb; Wayland sockets removed; private runtime and D-Bus session

initialFailures.cause: Both deprecated interceptBufferProtocol and protocol.handle failed to intercept native HTTPS navigation in this Electron/session setup, so the real public page was loaded.
initialFailures.fix: Use Playwright context request routing to deliver fixture HTML to actual Electron WebContents at its real HTTPS origin, and assert that it was served.

initialFailures.cause: New native Markdown menu test returned from sendInputEvent before Chromium emitted context-menu, and examined the menu before it opened.
initialFailures.fix: Await the actual native context-menu event before selecting an item. No retry, timeout relaxation, skipped assertion or scenario reduction.

limitations: Public Namu HTML was captured by ordinary HTTP and served with scripts and external resources disabled; this is evidence for the inspected markup, not all signed-in or future Namu layouts.
No challenge or unavailable-page bypass is implemented.
Markdown images remain remote URLs; this is not an offline asset archive.
The benchmark measures ordinary Markdown and Git source/reader transitions; it does not establish web Reader extraction or export latency.
Source and production build updated; the separately installed desktop app was not replaced.

benchmark.harness: candidate; same tests for both apps; five cycles per fresh process
benchmark.measurement: Escape keydown to latest-content nonempty native capture; includes polling/IPC/readback, not monitor presentation
